consumersChecked: StaticPrefs:: uses in intl/lwbrk/*.cpp and dom/base/nsLineBreaker.cpp: none. Line breaking opportunities have no pref at 156.

prefs.name: bidi.numeral
prefs.effect: FormatUnicodeText numeral shaping (nsBidiPresUtils.cpp:2019-2074). 0 = nominal: no digit substitution.

prefs.name: bidi.direction
prefs.effect: Document bidi option direction used by a connected canvas with direction 'inherit' and no style (CanvasRenderingContext2D.cpp:5142-5144).

prefs.name: browser.display.auto_quality_min_font_size
prefs.effect: text-rendering:auto sets TEXT_OPTIMIZE_SPEED below this many device px (nsLayoutUtils.cpp:6913-6919; canvas compares CSS px at CanvasRenderingContext2D.cpp:5198-5204). The flag only skips bounding boxes (nsTextFrame.cpp:2604); no width effect.

prefs.name: font.size.inflation.emPerLine
prefs.effect: Font inflation (mobile); 0 on desktop disables it.

prefs.name: font.size.inflation.minTwips
prefs.effect: Font inflation (mobile); 0 on desktop disables it.

prefs.name: gfx.font_rendering.coretext.enabled
prefs.effect: macOS: false -> all shaping through HarfBuzz (gfxMacFont.cpp:157).

prefs.name: gfx.font_rendering.fallback.async
prefs.effect: System font fallback may run asynchronously (gfxTextRun.cpp:3111, gfxPlatformFontList.cpp:1481): a first layout can use a temporary font and reflow later.

prefs.name: gfx.font_rendering.fallback.unassigned_chars
prefs.effect: No system fallback for unassigned code points (gfxTextRun.cpp:3525).

prefs.name: gfx.font_rendering.graphite.enabled
prefs.effect: Graphite shaping for fonts with Graphite tables (gfxFont.cpp:3495-3510).

prefs.name: gfx.font_rendering.wordcache.charlimit
prefs.effect: Words longer than 32 UTF-16 units are shaped straight into the run instead of the word cache (gfxFont.cpp:3736-3739, :3804-3811); same shaper, no width change.

prefs.name: layout.css.dpi
prefs.effect: Physical units only (nsDeviceContext.cpp:81-92).

prefs.name: layout.css.moz-control-character-visibility.enabled
prefs.effect: Exposes the property to content; off.

prefs.name: layout.css.devPixelsPerPx
prefs.effect: -1 = use the widget scale; sets app units per device pixel (nsDeviceContext.cpp:52-55, :94-98).

prefs.name: layout.css.control-characters.visible
prefs.effect: Initial value of -moz-control-character-visibility (servo values/specified/text.rs:932-939). Release: false -> Hidden -> TEXT_HIDE_CONTROL_CHARACTERS for DOM text (nsLayoutUtils.cpp:6905-6908): stray C0/C1 controls get no hexbox and no advance. An OffscreenCanvas has no style, so its runs keep hexboxes.

prefs.name: layout.css.intrinsic-size-first-letter.enabled
prefs.effect: ::first-letter intrinsic sizing (nsTextFrame.cpp:10112); not in plain paragraphs.

prefs.name: layout.css.letter-spacing.model
prefs.effect: DOM letter-spacing placement (nsTextFrame.cpp:4114-4133). Release value 0 = whole amount after each cluster (trailing side); only the position changes, the sum per frame is the same as model 1.

prefs.name: layout.css.text-transform.uppercase-eszett.enabled
prefs.effect: text-transform:uppercase maps U+00DF to 'SS' (false) instead of U+1E9E (nsTextFrame.cpp:2628, :11711).

prefs.name: layout.css.text-autospace.enabled
prefs.effect: Property enabled, but its initial value is no-autospace (servo properties/longhands.toml:2610-2612), so no inter-script spacing unless authored.

prefs.name: layout.css.text-wrap-balance.limit
prefs.effect: text-wrap: balance only (nsBlockFrame.cpp:1769, :1813).

prefs.name: layout.css.text-wrap-balance-after-clamp.enabled
prefs.effect: text-wrap: balance with line-clamp only (nsBlockFrame.cpp:1784).

prefs.name: layout.css.text-align.justify-only-after-last-tab
prefs.effect: text-align: justify with tabs only (nsTextFrame.cpp:3740).

prefs.name: layout.css.zoom.enabled
prefs.effect: CSS zoom property enabled.
